notes:
Method: read $SCRATCH/kb/current-knowledge.md, all 22 records in compact-old.json, the 9 new records with corrections, and grepped reviews/*.json (artificialanalysis.json check confirms AA values: Qwen3.8 27B TB2.1 0.7978 xhigh / 0.6517 medium; Qwen3.6-35B-A3B TB2.1 0.4494, tauBanking 0.0928). No browsing was needed.

Runtime correction applied to every old record: old fits name ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server-cuda13, but the baseline says server-cuda13-b12407 requires CUDA >= 13.5 and is likely refused on driver 595 (CUDA 13.2). All llama.cpp rankings therefore assume the pinned server-cuda-b12407 image (CUDA 12.8.1) with -e GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1 before the image name and -np 1.

Excluded and why: Nanbeige4.3-33B has the best AA index (20.4) but runs only as IQ2_M with q4_0 KV, b12407 mis-tokenizes it (the bartowski-key mitigation is refuted; needs --override-kv tokenizer.ggml.add_space_prefix=bool:false until PR #31986), dense 33B is slow, and it averages 158.5k output tokens per AA task. Xing4.0-29B-A4B: all scores self-reported with mislabeled comparators, no xing parser at b12407, public report of failing write/edit tool calls. LFM2.5-24B-A2B and Ternary Bonsai 2 27B: practical all-GPU fits but vendor-only quality, Bonsai has an independent regression. Mellum2.1: vendor table trails Qwen3.5-9B. Ornith-1.5-9B, KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev, Laguna XS 2.1: vendor-only. Nemotron 3.5 Lightning: NVIDIA's own TB2.1 24.58. Devstral Small 2: about 32k context. gpt-oss-120b: RAM marginal. DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B: no tool path.

Judgement calls: #1 vs #2 is close. Qwen3.8-27B wins clearly on independent quality, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B wins on practicality (128k, 4-bit, two agreeing independent sources), which is the stated priority. K2 Horizon 7B is above MoVA because it runs fully in VRAM with a large margin; MoVA has the higher scores but tight VRAM, heavy DDR5 offload and slow high-effort turns. Vendor-claim-only placements: #7 Groot and #8 Nemotron Bolt. Nothing here has been run on this machine. Every pick needs an OpenCode tool-call smoke test, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit with CDI has to be installed before any of them can run.
